approvedContract.recording: First valid contact starts a monotonic 60000ms foreground recording. Background, blur or exit interrupts an incomplete recording. Complete clips are durably saved before sending is offered.
approvedContract.counts: Completed touch gesture or successful Squeeze/Bonk button action counts once. Movement samples and cancellation do not inflate the count. Haptic onset follows contact, not a delayed long-pull release.
approvedContract.sendAllowance: Free: one per account per natural month. Effective Plus: one per account per natural day. Server-fixed economic calendar; same-day upgrade is not additive. Only a committed send consumes allowance.
approvedContract.recipientRetention: Free: latest ONE, replacing older unread too. Effective Plus: latest 30 days. Current-entitlement pruning on send/read/Push recheck; bounded hourly expiry cleanup.
approvedContract.readSemantics: Metadata, prepared/openable, unread and played are separate. History opening does not mark every message read. Explicit playback durably queues one message acknowledgement. A stale Push is bound to its immutable message ID, not redirected to an unrelated newer message.
approvedContract.visualEntitlement: Server catalog snapshot of the recorded toy is viewable only within the authorized message. No inventory, room editing, coin, task, rating or reward grant.
approvedContract.unlink: Server deletes pair content and pending touch notifications and rejects old-pair reads. Client clears pair-bound state when relationship change is detected. Non-content quota/idempotency tombstones remain to prevent unlink farming. Offline devices cannot be remotely erased before reconnecting.
approvedContract.photos: Existing shared private-photo cache and signed-read endpoint. A live current-pair message grants a narrow read of its sender-owned associated photo, including one uploaded while solo. Deleting the photo leaves toy/trajectory playback without resurrecting deleted photo bytes.
approvedContract.durability: Immutable payload and original key before optimistic acceptance. Timeouts retry the original request. Definitive rejection retains a recoverable recording. Receipt-confirmed sends cannot become rejected because local persistence or a listener fails. Root scope-storage errors stay within this feature.
approvedContract.transport: BurrowSyncGate remains sole owner of the authenticated shared realtime channel. Touch consumers use a payload-free account-scoped public signal adapter; unmounting them never closes another feature's channel. No full-bootstrap invalidation for a touch event.

renderingDecision.full: Existing local Skia deformation and native fallback; approximate contact locations and movement. No pixel-perfect replay promise.
renderingDecision.standard: Whole-toy squash/movement using native image layers; no replay Skia Canvas.
renderingDecision.light: Static toy, haptics and at most two pooled flying hearts.
renderingDecision.reason: Steady-state throughput was close to 60fps for all tiers, but full cold opening still produced a 401.876ms slow frame in the second trial. Full is therefore available as Detailed, not the universal default. Standard's extreme 999-action trial also contained one 53.391ms frame; zero slow frames on all devices is NOT claimed.
renderingDecision.timeline: One UI-thread cursor survives quality changes; no replay/recount or catch-up vibration burst. Stop on background, blur or exit.

nativeComparison.environment: iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.2 SIMULATOR, compatible existing Release native host, minified JS, Hermes. Real product toy/rendering/recording/playback components; bundled non-private face fixture; production business API prohibited.
nativeComparison.protocol: Two trials, six 60-second phases each: full/standard/light with the same normal 120-pull trajectory and extreme 999-button trajectory. No local compilation or test gate during formal sampling. UI-frame callback intervals, not a physical-device GPU/compositor trace.
nativeComparison.samplingCorrection: First trial included the frame driver's initial inactive-to-active interval. Second trial excludes only that initial interval, not legitimate later slow frames; the full cold-opening slow frame remains reported. Subsequent client refinements align contact haptics and add the standard default/detail selector without adding per-frame work or changing sample/particle/texture budgets; final actual-page gesture and selector flows were separately exercised.
nativeComparison.memoryCaveats: ps RSS for the entire simulator App every two seconds, not incremental feature allocation, physical footprint, GPU memory or battery consumption. Sequential same-process trials are affected by GC and cache warmup; first-phase RSS collection started late and does not include its complete cold peak. Ranges overlap, so small full/standard differences are not a precise memory saving claim.

bundleMeasurement.method: Production-mode minified Metro full-app JS with new entry/store/badge modules enabled versus no-op feature modules. Existing shared renderer/transport plumbing remains in both. This is not a byte-for-byte previous release or an IPA/APK download measurement.

dense haptic limiting and no late bursts
upgrade does not add a same-day send
message-only photo access and photo deletion
unlink content deletion with quota tombstone
nativeObserved: heart progress and pooled flying hearts
Sending before receipt and Sent after receipt
received toy opens without an inventory grant
History does not auto-play or consume all unread

limits: No physical iPhone/Android matrix, true motor sensation, low-memory OS-pressure run, GPU/compositor trace or APNs/FCM end-to-end delivery was measured. Those require physical devices and the new client build.
The isolated native comparison is not a full production Home/startup coexistence stress profile. Finite targeted results are not all historical tests or all devices passing.
All tiers had excellent percentile frame times, but occasional slow frames exist; no zero-jank or every-frame-under-50ms guarantee.
The server validates authorization, schema, bounds and quota, not proof of physical finger activity. This is bounded sender-authored social content with no task/reward value.
Client changes need a new app/dev bundle. API deployment does not silently install or publish an App Store/Google Play build.
